confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate with no live price checks. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately uncertain because Egyptian pound-denominated prices move with currency swings; accommodation (especially 3-star) and wine are least certain. The FX value comes from search-result excerpts of the RBA exchange-rate page, not a direct page read, and should be verified against the RBA series before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against budget Red Sea and South Sinai coastal tourist towns and Egyptian beach resorts, using the price tier of backpacker-oriented Dahab for hostels and guesthouses and a mid-range seafood-restaurant tier for dining. Egypt is classed as Africa (Northern Africa) for region purposes.
